description.value:
From C-Moon · Price: gravity points away from you, so it pushes allies near you too.

Theme Force and Energy

  • 1: 1 action: creatures and loose objects within 10 ft are pushed 5 ft away from you, allies included (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates). Or 1 action: flip one creature's gravity within 30 ft so it falls up and back down: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}); it falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone} on a critical failure.
  • 5: Surge: a creature your stand hits turns inside out: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}); @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 1} on a failure, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{stunned 1} on a critical failure.
  • 9: Push 10 ft, and a creature that critically fails the push falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone}; you can walk on walls.
  • 13: Emanation 20 ft. A target that fails the inside-out save is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{stunned 1} instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 1}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{stunned 2} instead of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{stunned 1} on a critical failure.
  • 17: Surge: reverse gravity in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]{30-ft emanation} for 1 round. Creatures you choose there (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates) fall upward 20 ft, then fall back, taking falling damage and landing @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone}; on a critical failure they're also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{stunned 1}.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
